description: This file contains abstract classes and implementations for widget actions, including value getters and setters, telemetry data handling, RPC commands, and related utility functions for a widget framework in an IoT platform (Thingsboard). It defines how widget actions interact with telemetry data, attributes, RPC, and dashboard states.

classes.name: BasicActionWidgetComponent
classes.description: Abstract base class for widget components handling actions, value retrieval, and updates within the widget framework.

classes.name: DataToValueConverter
classes.description: Converts data to widget value using configured functions or constants, supporting different data types.

classes.name: ValueAction
classes.description: Abstract class representing an action that can be performed, with error handling.

classes.name: ValueGetter
classes.description: Abstract class for retrieving widget values, supporting various data sources and actions.

classes.name: ValueToDataConverter
classes.description: Converts widget values to data using functions, constants, or direct values.

classes.name: ValueSetter
classes.description: Abstract class for setting widget values, supporting RPC and attribute updates.

classes.name: DefaultValueGetter
classes.description: Returns a default value without fetching from external sources.

classes.name: ExecuteRpcValueGetter
classes.description: Retrieves value via RPC command execution.

classes.name: TelemetryValueGetter
classes.description: Retrieves telemetry data (attributes, time series, alarm status) for a widget.

classes.name: AttributeValueGetter
classes.description: Retrieves attribute data from an entity.

classes.name: DashboardStateWithParamsGetter
classes.description: Gets current dashboard state with parameters.

classes.name: TelemetryValueSetter
classes.description: Sets telemetry data (attributes or time series).

methods.name: createValueGetter
methods.description: Factory method to create appropriate ValueGetter based on settings.

methods.name: createValueSetter
methods.description: Factory method to create appropriate ValueSetter based on settings.

methods.name: dataToValue
methods.description: Converts raw data to widget value using configured function or constant.

methods.name: valueToData
methods.description: Converts widget value to data for transmission.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets widget value via configured method (RPC, attribute, time series).

methods.name: doGetValue
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve value from source.

methods.name: doSetValue
methods.description: Abstract method to set value to target.

methods.name: doSetTelemetryValue
methods.description: Sets telemetry data (attributes or time series).

methods.name: doGetValue
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve telemetry data.
